capabilities.body: OpenAmer itegura igikorwa, ikagikora ikoresheje ibikoresho nyabyo — umurongo w'amabwiriza, mushakisha, amadosiye, kode — kandi ikabika ibyagenze neza.
capabilities.title: Umufasha utekerezanya nawe

capabilities.body: Ibiganiro, ibyo yibuka n'imodeli biguma kuri iyi mudasobwa. Nta cyo yohereza utabimusabye.
capabilities.title: Ibikoresho byawe, amakuru yawe

capabilities.body: Indimi 186, buri rumwe mu nyandiko usanzwe usoma. Mugaragaza ya mbere ya porogaramu ikubaza urwo uhitamo.
capabilities.title: Ururimi rwawe, uko bikwiye

capabilities.body: Ubumenyi bubikwa buvuye mu mirimo ikorwa, bityo imirimo ya buri munsi ikarushaho kwihuta uko uyikoresha.
capabilities.title: Ubushobozi bukura

help: Reba ko iyi mudasobwa ishobora kugera kuri interineti.
Ongera utangize iyinjizamo — intambwe zarangiye ntizisubirwamo.
Ninanirwa kabiri, fungura inyandiko z'ibikorwa; imirongo ya nyuma igaragaza intambwe byahagazeho.
failure.lead: Nta mpinduka zasubijwe inyuma utabimenyeshejwe — OpenAmer ihagarara aho yari igeze, ku buryo niwongera kuyitangiza izakomereza aho.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer iracyari kuri verisiyo ya mbere kandi iracyakora. Nta cyasimbujwe igice gusa.
failure.title: Iyinjizamo ntiryarangiye

language.lead: Iyinjizamo rirakomeza mu rurimi uhitamo hano. Ushobora kuruhindura nyuma muri porogaramu.
language.title: Hitamo ururimi rwawe

progress.lead: Iyinjizamo rikorwa rimwe gusa: OpenAmer iri kuvana kuri interineti ibyo ikeneye no kugena iyi mudasobwa. Mu kuyitangiza ubutaha, ibi byose ntibizongera gukorwa.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer iri gusimbura verisiyo ya mbere. Ibihe byawe by'akazi, ibyo yibuka n'amagenamiterere ntibihinduka.
progress.title: Kwinjiza OpenAmer

cards.body: Fungura porogaramu usobanure icyo ushaka ko ikora. OpenAmer ikorera mu bwihisho ikakumenyesha ibivuyemo.
cards.title: Tangirira ku nteruro

cards.body: Amagenamiterere → Imigaragarire → Ururimi. Indimi n'uturere 186, ushobora kubihindura igihe cyose.
cards.title: Hitamo ururimi rwawe

cards.body: Umurimo usubirwamo uhinduka ubumenyi — ubutaha ukenera ibwiriza rimwe gusa.
cards.title: Reka yibuke

success.command: cyangwa uyitangize nyuma ukoresheje umurongo w'amabwiriza:
success.lead: Byose biri mu mwanya wabyo. OpenAmer ubu ni iyawe — kuri iyi mudasobwa, mu rurimi rwawe.
success.title: OpenAmer iriteguye

bullets: Ikorera kuri iyi mudasobwa — ibiganiro byawe biguma kuri yo
Byose bishobora guhindurwa nyuma; nta kidahinduka
welcome.lead: Umufasha wawe bwite. Ku bikoresho byawe. Mu rurimi rwawe.
welcome.leadUpdate: Verisiyo nshya ya OpenAmer iriteguye. Isimbura iya mbere kandi ikagumana ibihe byose by'akazi n'amagenamiterere.
welcome.note: Bifata iminota mike kuri interineti isanzwe.
welcome.title: Ikaze muri OpenAmer
